article_content: Northampton triumphed over their rivals, Leicester, in a thrilling Premiership semi-final match on Friday. With just two minutes left, a try by England's Tom Wood secured Northampton's place in the Twickenham final later this month; this victory came after Leicester had led by 17-6 at the half. Northampton's path to victory was challenging, especially after Salesi Ma’afu received a red card for striking England hooker Tom Youngs early in the second half. Wood's try on the left flank ignited Northampton's supporters, ending their four-year winless streak against Leicester. Key players for Northampton included Foden, Collins, George Pisi, Burrell, and Myler. Leicester's team featured Tait, Morris, Tuilagi, Flood, and Youngs. The referee for the match was JP Doyle, and the attendance was 13,591. The game's intensity was notable, with Tom Wood describing it as the most intense match he had ever played. Leicester's director of rugby, Richard Cockerill, acknowledged that their indiscipline was a significant factor in their defeat. Northampton's director of rugby, Jim Mallinder, expressed that his team deserved the victory, highlighting their resilience in the face of adversity. The rivalry between Northampton and Leicester is fierce, intensified by the presence of numerous England players and Leicester's past dominance. Manu Tuilagi's performance was noteworthy, challenging Northampton’s Luther Burrell. Stephen Myler contributed crucial points for Northampton.

article_content: In some circles, it was hailed as a victory for computer 'nerds' over the world of celebrity. Music super couple Jay-Z and Beyonce were reportedly outbid in their quest to purchase the most expensive mansion in Beverly Hills by Markus 'Notch' Persson, the creator of the popular online video game Minecraft. Persson is believed to have paid $70 million for the eight-bedroom house, which features 15 bathrooms, a 16-car garage, an infinity pool, a wine cellar, a private theater, and a sweet shop. Scroll down for video. A super-fan created a Minecraft version of the luxury cliff-side compound, mimicking an official tour video in impressive detail. Persson, the creator of Minecraft, is believed to have paid $70 million for the stunning eight-bedroom house. The home features 15 bathrooms, a 16-car garage, an infinity pool, a wine cellar, a private theater, and a sweet shop. UK web developer and passionate Minecraft user Dan Bovey paid tribute to Persson's acquisition by recreating a video tour of the property in Minecraft itself. Imitating the real-life promotional video, the Minecraft version guides the viewer through the luxury cliffside compound, mimicking the original in close detail. The video sweeps over the pool and garden with panoramic views of Malibu and downtown LA and hovers over the infinity pool before guiding the viewer through the property's lavish interior. Bovey, who is studying Web Development at Staffordshire University, meticulously copied the tour using software that uses individual blocks to create 3D virtual worlds. After sweeping over the pool and garden, the virtual tour transitions to the property's lavish interior. The reconstruction was the work of Dan Bovey, a UK web developer and Minecraft enthusiast. Minecraft users build their virtual worlds with individual building blocks, similar to an online form of Lego. It was reported that Beyoncé and Jay-Z had their sights set on the compound but were outbid by Persson. Views of the city's landscape are visible from the giant floor-to-ceiling windows in the extensive living area. It was reported that Beyoncé and Jay-Z had their eyes set on the compound and were reportedly 'on the verge of closing a deal' earlier this month after visiting the home six times. Minecraft was created in 2009. At the start of the game, a player enters a 'virtually infinite game world.' Players can explore different terrains, including mountains, forests, and caves, and are given blocks and tools to build towns and cities. The game was initially made for the PC, but there are now Xbox 360 and mobile versions available. It is the top online game on Xbox Live, with more than two billion hours played on Xbox 360 in the last two years and almost 17 million copies sold in total. In September, Microsoft acquired Persson's company, Mojang, and the game for an estimated £1.5 billion (approximately $2.5 billion USD at the time). The reason for the turn of events, which found Persson closing the deal 'in a lightning-fast six days,' according to real estate brokers John Aaroe Group, is unknown. The impressive residence sits on 23,000 square feet and includes an attached 16-car garage and a backyard patio with panoramic views of Malibu and downtown LA. Even inside, views of the city's landscape are visible from the many floor-to-ceiling windows and foldable doors off the living room. The master bedroom features his-and-hers walk-in closets with plenty of mirrors and storage space for A-list-worthy wardrobes. Home movies take on a new meaning in a private theater with seating for 24, while snacking on treats is convenient with a sweet shop stocked with cascading candy dispensers. Adults can store a substantial amount of bottles in the house's large wine cellar. Beyonce and Jay-Z, who had looked at the home on more than one occasion, were outbid for the estate by Markus Persson. article_content: According to a new report, older people are a benefit to the economy and society, rather than a burden. Researchers from the University College London (UCL) School of Pharmacy challenge the view that older people are a major source of economic problems, such as reduced international competitiveness. Their study provides evidence that the benefits of increased longevity will outweigh the additional health and social care costs associated with an aging population. A UCL study indicates that the elderly contribute billions to the economy. 'Old age is often perceived as a time of increasing dependency, vulnerability, and frailty. However, older people already contribute significantly to the wellbeing of their families and the wider community,' said Dr. Jennifer Gill, co-author of the report. Life expectancy at 65 has increased by six years since the 1950s, and as people live longer, they tend to stay healthier at any given age. These advances have been partly driven by the pharmaceutical revolution of 1950-2000. Medicines for conditions like heart attacks, strokes, and diabetes are now well understood and have significantly contributed to falling death and disability rates, despite challenges such as obesity. 'In the coming decades, greater participation by people in their 60s and 70s in formal and informal work, alongside further decreases in the number of years spent with major disabilities, could increase national productivity by up to 10 percent of GDP,' said Dr. Gill. One example of how older individuals contribute to the economy is Silver Saints, a London-based handyman service that employs men of advancing years, including one aged 62 and, until recently, another aged 68. Jordan Taylor, Operations Manager at Silver Saints, told MailOnline: 'We find that their experience and exposure to life give them a calmer approach to the job. They are more confident, and female customers are certainly more at ease with the older gentlemen.' Estimates from the 1980s and 1990s suggest that only 0.2 percent of the annual increase in NHS spending was due to population aging. Hospital costs for the elderly are outweighed by their positive economic contributions. Although the current figure is around one percent per annum, these cost increases have been offset by the £40 billion contributed to the British economy in 2010 by adults aged 65 and over. It is estimated that by 2030, retired 'baby boomers' will contribute £80 billion to the economy. The team emphasizes that even if older people require long-term supportive care, they will not necessarily be an economic burden. Co-author Professor David Taylor said: 'For example, the additional public cost of the recent Dilnot proposals to make residential and community care more fairly available in England would probably be under 0.2 percent of the current UK Gross National Product, if implemented.'
translated_content: Ifølge en ny rapport er ældre mennesker en fordel for økonomien og samfundet, snarere end en byrde. Forskere fra University College London (UCL) School of Pharmacy udfordrer synspunktet om, at ældre mennesker er en væsentlig kilde til økonomiske problemer, såsom reduceret international konkurrenceevne. Deres undersøgelse viser, at fordelene ved øget levealder opvejer de ekstra sundheds- og sociale omkostninger forbundet med en aldrende befolkning. En undersøgelse fra UCL viser, at ældre bidrager med milliarder til økonomien. 'Ældredom bliver ofte set som en tid med stigende afhængighed, sårbarhed og skrøbelighed. Men ældre bidrager allerede markant til deres familiers og samfundets trivsel,' siger Dr. Jennifer Gill, medforfatter til rapporten. Den forventede levetid ved 65 år er steget med seks år siden 1950'erne, og folk lever generelt sundere, jo længere de lever. Disse fremskridt skyldes delvist den farmaceutiske revolution fra 1950-2000. Medicin mod sygdomme som hjerteanfald, slagtilfælde og diabetes er nu velkendte og har bidraget væsentligt til at reducere døds- og invaliditetsraterne, på trods af udfordringer som fedme. 'I de kommende årtier kan øget deltagelse af folk i 60'erne og 70'erne i formelt og uformelt arbejde samt et fald i antallet af leveår med alvorlige handicap øge den nationale produktivitet med op til 10 procent af BNP,' udtaler Dr. Gill. Et eksempel på, hvordan ældre bidrager til økonomien, er Silver Saints, en London-baseret handyman-service, der ansætter mænd i den fremskredne alder, herunder en på 62 år og indtil for nylig en på 68 år. Jordan Taylor, driftsleder hos Silver Saints, fortalte MailOnline: 'Vi oplever, at deres erfaring og livserfaring giver dem en mere rolig tilgang til jobbet. De er mere selvsikre, og kvindelige kunder er mere trygge ved de ældre herrer.' Estimater fra 1980'erne og 1990'erne viser, at kun 0,2 procent af den årlige stigning i NHS' udgifter skyldtes befolkningens aldring. Ældres hospitalsomkostninger opvejes af deres positive økonomiske bidrag. Selvom det nuværende tal er omkring én procent om året, er disse omkostningsstigninger blevet opvejet af de 40 milliarder pund, som voksne på 65 år og derover bidrog med til den britiske økonomi i 2010. Det skønnes, at pensionerede 'babyboomere' vil bidrage med 80 milliarder pund til økonomien i 2030. Holdet understreger, at selvom ældre har brug for langvarig pleje, vil de ikke nødvendigvis være en økonomisk byrde. Medforfatter professor David Taylor siger: 'For eksempel vil de ekstra offentlige omkostninger ved de nylige Dilnot-forslag om at gøre bolig- og hjemmepleje mere retfærdigt tilgængelig i England sandsynligvis være under 0,2 procent af det nuværende britiske bruttonationalprodukt, hvis de implementeres.'

article_content: Following a disappointing World Cup campaign where they failed to reach the semifinals, England's cricket team has announced its squad for the upcoming tour of the West Indies, set to begin on December 3. Captain Jos Buttler will lead a team that includes six players who were part of the World Cup squad. Notably absent from both the One Day International (ODI) and Twenty20 International (T20I) squads is Ben Stokes. Stokes, who reversed his ODI retirement to participate in the World Cup, is scheduled to undergo knee surgery after returning from India. The squads feature uncapped pace bowlers Josh Tongue and John Turner, offering them an opportunity to make their international debuts. The players retained from the World Cup squad are Jos Buttler, Gus Atkinson, Harry Brook, Brydon Carse, Sam Curran, and Liam Livingstone. They will participate in three ODIs and five T20Is in the Caribbean. Despite England's poor showing in the World Cup, Buttler has indicated that he doesn't foresee major changes to the team's overall strategy. He acknowledged the need for adjustments to regain their status as a top-tier team but cautioned against a complete clear-out. The ODI squad includes: Jos Buttler (captain), Rehan Ahmed, Gus Atkinson, Harry Brook, Brydon Carse, Zak Crawley, Sam Curran, Ben Duckett, Tom Hartley, Will Jacks, Liam Livingstone, Ollie Pope, Phil Salt, Josh Tongue, and John Turner. The T20I squad comprises: Jos Buttler (captain), Rehan Ahmed, Moeen Ali, Gus Atkinson, Harry Brook, Sam Curran, Ben Duckett, Will Jacks, Liam Livingstone, Tymal Mills, Adil Rashid, Phil Salt, Josh Tongue, Reece Topley, John Turner, and Chris Woakes.

article_content: According to a preliminary report by the National Transportation Safety Board, a Learjet departing Chicago's Midway airport last month came within approximately two plane-lengths of colliding with a taxiing Southwest Airlines Boeing 737. The Southwest Airlines plane had been cleared to cross the same runway. The NTSB, which is investigating the incident, stated that the airborne Learjet passed 62 feet above and 287 feet laterally from the Southwest passenger plane. The NTSB reported that the co-pilot of the taxiing Southwest jet saw the Learjet and yelled 'Stop' to the captain, who stopped the plane near the runway's edge. Air traffic control audio tapes, obtained from LiveATC.net, a website for aviation enthusiasts, captured conversations between the Southwest crew and controllers shortly after the incident. One of the pilots said to controllers, 'You just cleared us onto a runway where there was a plane taking off.' Another pilot, sounding frustrated, added, 'What technology clears us on the runway when a plane was taking off?' The Southwest crew then contacted another controller, stating, 'We had to hit our brakes and the thing went right over our head.' The NTSB's preliminary report indicates that the incident occurred around 9 a.m. CT on December 1. A Learjet 45 was instructed to line up and wait on runway 31 right, while Southwest Flight 844 had landed on the parallel runway, 31 center. As the Southwest plane decelerated on the center runway, the Learjet received clearance for takeoff on the right runway. A potential conflict arose when an air traffic controller cleared the Southwest plane to turn right onto a taxiway that crossed the right runway. Kevin Hiatt, a former 737 pilot with the Flight Safety Foundation, a non-profit organization, noted that the cause of the near miss remains unclear. However, he commended the Southwest co-pilot for preventing a possible disaster. 'Fortunately, the first officer was alert and saw the Learjet approaching. He told the captain to stop, which he did just before entering the active runway,' Hiatt said. 'If that Learjet had experienced any problem and failed to lift off, they prevented a very serious accident.' Hiatt mentioned that Midway airport is one of 35 airports that use an surface movement detection system, ASDE-X, to detect potential runway conflicts. 'The investigation will likely examine whether ASDE-X was operational at the time and whether the controllers were using it,' he said. The NTSB emphasized that the report is preliminary and no blame has been assigned. No injuries were reported. CNN's Mary Snow contributed to this report.

Southwest-besætningen kontaktede derefter en anden kontrollør og sagde: 'Vi var nødt til at træde på bremsen, og den gik lige over hovedet på os.' NTSB's foreløbige rapport indikerer, at hændelsen fandt sted omkring kl. 9.00 CT den 1. december. Kevin Hiatt, en tidligere 737-pilot hos Flight Safety Foundation, en nonprofitorganisation, bemærkede, at årsagen til den nære kollision stadig er uklar. Han roste dog Southwest-co-piloten for at have forhindret en mulig katastrofe. 'Heldigvis var styrmanden opmærksom og så Learjet nærme sig. Han bad kaptajnen om at stoppe, hvilket han gjorde lige før han kørte ind på den aktive landingsbane,' sagde Hiatt. 'Hvis den Learjet havde haft et problem og ikke var lettet, havde de forhindret en meget alvorlig ulykke.' Hiatt nævnte, at Midway lufthavn er en af 35 lufthavne, der bruger et overfladebevægelsesdetekteringssystem, ASDE-X, til at opdage potentielle landingsbanekonflikter. 'Undersøgelsen vil sandsynligvis undersøge, om ASDE-X var i drift på det tidspunkt, og om kontrollørerne brugte det,' sagde han. NTSB understregede, at rapporten er foreløbig, og at der ikke er placeret skyld. Ingen personskader blev rapporteret. CNN's Mary Snow bidrog til denne rapport.

article_content: By Wills Robinson Published: 12:10 EST, October 12, 2013 | Updated: 12:12 EST, October 12, 2013 A 13-month-old baby, who was on the brink of death when his heart stopped for nine minutes, is making a miraculous recovery at home with his family. Bobby Hutley was struck down with a deadly strain of bacterial meningitis in February and was rushed to the hospital. His condition dramatically deteriorated, and his terrified parents, Glen, 25, and Stacie, 24, could only watch as medics performed CPR on their little boy. Recovery: Bobby Hutley was close to death when he contracted bacterial meningitis, and his heart stopped for nine minutes. Miraculously, Bobby's heart restarted, and he pulled through. The critically ill infant spent 12 days in intensive care and another two weeks in the hospital before finally being allowed home on May 21. Courageous Bobby is now going from strength to strength after winning his bitter fight for life. Grateful Glen and Stacie, of Thetford, Norfolk, are now setting out to raise money for Meningitis UK to thank the charity for their help and support during their traumatic ordeal. Glen, his father, said: 'We call Bobby our miracle little boy, and we want to do our best for the charity that helped us.' He said Bobby fell ill in February and was taken by Stacie to see their GP. She was told he had a chest infection, and they should give him plenty of fluids. But Bobby's condition steadily worsened, and he developed a persistent rash. His worried parents took him to the A&E unit at West Suffolk Hospital in Bury St Edmunds, where he was diagnosed with bacterial meningitis. Bobby was immediately transferred to Addenbrookes Hospital in Cambridge. 'The feeling of anxiety was absolutely horrific; it was a horrendous time,' said Glen. The devastated Hutleys feared they were going to lose their only child when Bobby's heart suddenly stopped. Remarkable: Bobby's parents, Glen, 25, and Stacie, 24, say their only child has little scarring, and his awareness is fantastic. 'I thought if they do bring him round, what is going to happen from there? What quality of life is he going to have?' 'But it is a true miracle that he is walking again now, and his awareness is fantastic,' said Glen. 'People look at him, and they don't suspect he has had meningitis because all he has been left with is minor scarring.' Stacie said that since Bobby is doing really well, he has had a string of hospital and follow-up appointments to monitor his progress. The sales assistant said: 'It took him a while to come back to his former self.' 'When he first came out of the hospital, he was like a newborn baby; he could not even hold his head up.' 'But now Bobby's walking and talking, and he is doing really well.' 'He has had a few problems with his left eye; he has a bit of a lazy eye, but he has not had to go to the hospital about it.' Stacie spoke of her shock when Bobby was confirmed to have meningitis. 'Bobby was a well, happy boy, and I did not see anything like that coming, and it seriously affected our whole family,' she said. Stacie praised her family for their backing throughout that nightmare time, as well as saluting Meningitis UK. 'It was nice to know that their support was there as an option if we wanted to talk about it,' she said. 'It is very difficult to speak to somebody who has not been through the experience, so it is nice to be able to share your thoughts and feelings with somebody who had.' The Hutleys are to hold a ball at Sprowston Manor Hotel in Norwich on October 26 to raise money for Meningitis UK.

Men Bobbys tilstand blev støt forværret, og han udviklede et vedvarende udslæt. Hans bekymrede forældre tog ham på skadestuen på West Suffolk Hospital i Bury St Edmunds, hvor han blev diagnosticeret med bakteriel meningitis. Bobby blev straks overført til Addenbrookes Hospital i Cambridge. 'Følelsen af angst var absolut forfærdelig; det var en frygtelig tid,' sagde Glen. De knuste Hutleys frygtede, at de ville miste deres eneste barn, da Bobbys hjerte pludselig stoppede. Bemærkelsesværdigt: Bobbys forældre, Glen, 25, og Stacie, 24, siger, at deres eneste barn har få ar, og hans opmærksomhed er fantastisk. 'Jeg tænkte, hvis de bringer ham tilbage, hvad kommer der så til at ske derfra? Hvilken livskvalitet kommer han til at have?' 'Men det er et sandt mirakel, at han går igen nu, og hans opmærksomhed er fantastisk,' sagde Glen. 'Folk ser på ham, og de mistænker ikke, at han har haft meningitis, fordi alt, hvad han er blevet efterladt med, er mindre ar.' Stacie sagde, at da Bobby har det rigtig godt, har han haft en række hospitals- og opfølgningsaftaler for at overvåge hans fremskridt. Salgsassistenten sagde: 'Det tog ham et stykke tid at komme tilbage til sit tidligere jeg.' 'Da han først kom ud af hospitalet, var han som en nyfødt baby; han kunne ikke engang holde hovedet oppe.' 'Men nu går og taler Bobby, og han har det rigtig godt.' 'Han har haft et par problemer med sit venstre øje; han har lidt et dovent øje, men han har ikke været nødt til at gå på hospitalet med det.' Stacie talte om sit chok, da Bobby blev bekræftet at have meningitis. 'Bobby var en rask og glad dreng, og jeg så ikke noget lignende komme, og det påvirkede hele vores familie,' sagde hun. Stacie roste sin familie for deres opbakning i hele den mareridtsagtige tid, samt hyldede Meningitis UK. 'Det var rart at vide, at deres støtte var der som en mulighed, hvis vi ønskede at tale om det,' sagde hun. 'Det er meget svært at tale med nogen, der ikke har været igennem oplevelsen, så det er rart at kunne dele dine tanker og følelser med nogen, der havde.' Hutleys holder en bal på Sprowston Manor Hotel i Norwich den 26. oktober for at samle penge ind til Meningitis UK.

article_content: Jesse Helt, the young man who accompanied Miley Cyrus to the MTV Video Music Awards, received a reprimand from an Oregon judge on Tuesday after arriving 45 minutes late to a court hearing. Helt, 22, made his first court appearance since turning himself in last month for a probation violation. The aspiring model, currently out on $2500 bail, was admonished by a Polk County judge for his lateness and for missing the initial call of his name, according to court officials. Jesse Helt, known for attending the MTV Video Music Awards with Miley Cyrus, was reprimanded by an Oregon judge Tuesday for being 45 minutes late. Helt appeared in the Dallas, Oregon courtroom looking disheveled in a white t-shirt with uncombed blond hair. Helt appeared alongside his attorney, whose services Miley Cyrus is paying for. The judge warned Helt to 'bring a toothbrush' if he is late to his next probation violation hearing next month, which will determine whether he returns to jail or continues probation. Helt’s mother, Linda, told local media last month that Miley Cyrus is paying for his attorney. The singer was not present in court, but it seemed Helt could have used her assistance to arrive on time. Miley was seen riding a three-wheeled motorbike around Beverly Hills on Monday with her 14-year-old sister, Noah, holding on behind her. Perhaps Helt could have used a ride. The two were seen riding the gunmetal-colored Can-Am Spyder motorcycle by BRP through the streets of the affluent neighborhood. According to People, Miley Cyrus received the motored trike as a 21st birthday gift from her father, Billy Ray Cyrus. Helt rose to fame after appearing on stage with Cyrus at the MTV Video Music Awards in Los Angeles to raise awareness about homeless youth. Standing next to Cyrus, who was visibly emotional, the Salem, Oregon native stated that he was 'accepting this award on behalf of the 1.6 million runaways and homeless youth in the United States who are starving, lost, and scared for their lives right now.' 'I know this because I am one of these people,' he added. Helt gained notoriety after accompanying Miley Cyrus to the MTV Video Music Awards in August. Days after the award ceremony, it was revealed that Helt was wanted by Oregon authorities for violating his probation. He had pleaded guilty to misdemeanor criminal mischief and criminal trespass charges in 2010 for breaking into a home believing the occupant was selling bad marijuana, according to court records. Helt was initially sentenced to 30 days in jail and probation. However, instead of completing his probation, he moved to Los Angeles and lived on the streets while attempting to start a career in show business. Cyrus stated that she met Helt while visiting the Hollywood homeless center, My Friend's Place. Helt’s next court appearance is scheduled for October 7th. Miley Cyrus received the motored trike as a 21st birthday gift from her father, Billy Ray Cyrus.

article_content: A Russian man is being celebrated as a hero for rescuing a dog that had fallen into a frozen pond. The rescuer, known only as Ivan, was filmed breaking through the ice to save the drowning animal. The footage captures the 21-year-old, shirtless, using his arms to clear a path through the ice towards the dog, which was struggling about ten meters from the shore. Ivan managed to pull the dog from the water and bring it to safety. According to reports from the Russian news channel m24.ru, Ivan was assisting a stranded motorist near the pond when he heard the dog's cries for help. Finding that the dog had no owner, Ivan decided to adopt him and named him Rex. The pair are now said to be inseparable. During an interview at their home, both safe and warm, Rex was seen affectionately interacting with Ivan. The video of Ivan's icy rescue has garnered over 130,000 views online. While many are praising his brave actions, some have pointed out the potential risks involved for both Ivan and the dog. One commenter stated they wouldn't have been physically capable of doing the same. The incident reportedly occurred last March in a village outside Moscow. The Russian capital is currently experiencing lows of minus 12 Celsius.

article_content: In 2013, the Bank of England's expenditure on wine and champagne nearly doubled, totaling £7,990 for 756 bottles. This represents a 94% increase from the £4,126 spent on 444 bottles in 2012, according to reports. A significant portion of this spending was allocated to farewell celebrations for departing senior executives, notably former Governor Mervyn King. Deputy Governor Paul Tucker, Finance Director Warwick Jones, and HR Director Catherine Brown also received leaving parties. This increased spending occurred during a period when the economy was just beginning to recover from recession, potentially raising concerns. The Bank of England reportedly held one of the most impressive wine cellars in London, second only to the Stock Exchange. Over £26,000 was spent on gifts and parties to commemorate Lord King's retirement after a decade as governor, a sum comparable to the average UK worker's salary. The expenses for Mervyn King's farewell included a £10,000 portrait of himself, a £2,505 bust of Johann Wolfgang von Goethe, and a £597 silver napkin ring, in addition to three events costing £13,423. Nemat Shafik was recently appointed as only the second female Deputy Governor in the Bank’s 320-year history. Mr. Tucker received two leaving parties costing £9,164.75. He departed shortly after Mark Carney succeeded Lord King and following the Libor rate-rigging scandal. The Bank of England is owned by the Treasury but is funded by sources including interest-free deposits from lenders, which it invests. A Bank of England spokesperson stated that receptions are a necessary part of engaging with various economic and international stakeholders, and that bulk purchases help save costs. The spokesperson added that several leaving events, including those for the outgoing Governor and Deputy Governor, contributed to the increased spending in 2013.
translated_content: I 2013 næsten fordoblede Bank of England sine udgifter til vin og champagne, hvilket beløb sig til 7.990 £ for 756 flasker. Dette repræsenterer en stigning på 94 % i forhold til de 4.126 £, der blev brugt på 444 flasker i 2012, ifølge rapporter. En betydelig del af disse udgifter gik til afskedsfejringer for afgående ledende medarbejdere, især den tidligere guvernør Mervyn King. Viceguvernør Paul Tucker, finansdirektør Warwick Jones og HR-direktør Catherine Brown fik også afskedsfester. Disse øgede udgifter fandt sted i en periode, hvor økonomien netop var begyndt at komme sig efter en recession, hvilket potentielt giver anledning til bekymring. Bank of England skulle efter sigende have haft en af de mest imponerende vinkældre i London, kun overgået af børsen. Over 26.000 £ blev brugt på gaver og fester for at fejre Lord Kings pensionering efter et årti som guvernør, et beløb der kan sammenlignes med en gennemsnitlig britisk arbejders løn. Udgifterne til Mervyn Kings afsked omfattede et portræt af ham selv til 10.000 £, en buste af Johann Wolfgang von Goethe til 2.505 £ og en sølvservietring til 597 £, foruden tre arrangementer til en pris af 13.423 £. Nemat Shafik blev for nylig udnævnt som kun den anden kvindelige viceguvernør i Bankens 320-årige historie. Paul Tucker fik to afskedsfester, der kostede 9.164,75 £. Han fratrådte kort tid efter, at Mark Carney efterfulgte Lord King og i kølvandet på Libor-rentesvindelskandalen. Bank of England ejes af finansministeriet, men finansieres af forskellige kilder, herunder rentefrie indskud fra långivere, som den investerer i. En talsmand for Bank of England udtalte, at receptioner er en nødvendig del af engagementet med forskellige økonomiske og internationale interessenter, og at indkøb i store partier bidrager til at spare omkostninger. Talsmanden tilføjede, at adskillige afskedsarrangementer, herunder dem for den afgående guvernør og viceguvernør, bidrog til de øgede udgifter i 2013.

article_content: Ashley Cole's return to Roma's first team was short-lived after the veteran left-back was forced off during their Coppa Italia quarter-final victory against Empoli. The 34-year-old, whose last appearance for the Italian team was in a league win against Atalanta on November 22, appeared dazed after receiving an accidental kick to the chin from Empoli midfielder Matias Vecino midway through the first half. Cole was carried off the field on a medical buggy following the collision and was replaced by Jose Cholevas in the 24th minute. He did not return to the game. Despite the setback of Cole's injury, Rudi Garcia's team, aiming for a record-breaking 10th trophy in the competition, led at half-time thanks to a goal from Juan Iturbe. However, the hosts were unable to maintain their lead in normal time as Simone Verdi scored late for the visitors, sending the game into extra time. Garcia's side ultimately emerged victorious, with Daniele De Rossi scoring the decisive penalty with six minutes remaining in extra time.

Cole blev kørt fra banen på en medicinsk vogn efter sammenstødet og erstattet af Jose Cholevas i det 24. minut. Han vendte ikke tilbage i spillet. På trods af Coles skade førte Rudi Garcias hold, der jagtede deres 10. trofæ i turneringen, ved pausen takket være et mål af Juan Iturbe. Hjemmeholdet kunne dog ikke holde føringen i ordinær spilletid, da Simone Verdi scorede for gæsterne og tvang kampen ud i forlænget spilletid. Garcias hold endte med at vinde, da Daniele De Rossi scorede det afgørende straffespark med seks minutter tilbage af den forlængede spilletid.

article_content: Larry Matthew Puckett, aged 35, was executed via lethal injection earlier today. He was convicted for the 1995 murder of Rhonda Hatten Griffis, where he sexually assaulted and fatally beat her with an axe handle. The execution took place at 6:18 pm at the Mississippi State Penitentiary. At the time of the crime, Puckett was 18 years old and an Eagle Scout. Rhonda Hatten Griffis was a 28-year-old mother of two. Her body was discovered in her mobile home on October 14, 1995. Puckett had previously worked for the victim's husband, David Griffis, as a landscaper and was scheduled to begin Navy basic training soon after. Nancy Hatten, the victim's mother, testified that she found Puckett in the home near her daughter's body holding what she described as a club. Puckett claimed he was having an affair with Griffis and that her husband caught them. He also alleged Mr. Griffis was the actual killer, a claim his supporters continued to make leading up to the execution. Puckett was sentenced to death on August 5, 1996. Governor Bryant rejected a last-minute appeal. Before his execution, Puckett spent time with family and a spiritual advisor. His last meal included Macadamia nut pancakes, shrimp and grits, ice cream cake, caramel candy, and root beer. Puckett requested that his family and lawyer not attend his execution. However, Mrs. Griffis' parents were present. An online petition to halt the execution garnered around 4,000 signatures. Outside the prison, protesters gathered to demonstrate against the death penalty.

Henrettelsen fandt sted kl. 18.18 i Mississippi State Penitentiary. På tidspunktet for forbrydelsen var Puckett 18 år gammel og Eagle Scout. Rhonda Hatten Griffis var en 28-årig mor til to børn. Hendes lig blev fundet i hendes mobile hjem den 14. oktober 1995. Puckett hævdede, at han havde en affære med Griffis, og at hendes mand overraskede dem. Han påstod også, at hr. Griffis var den faktiske morder, en påstand hans tilhængere fortsatte med at fremsætte helt op til henrettelsen. Puckett blev dømt til døden den 5. august 1996. Guvernør Bryant afviste en appel i sidste øjeblik. Før sin henrettelse tilbragte Puckett tid med sin familie og en åndelig vejleder. Hans sidste måltid bestod af Macadamia-pandekager, rejer med gryn, islagkage, karamel og root beer. Puckett anmodede om, at hans familie og advokat ikke skulle overvære hans henrettelse. Dog var fru Griffis' forældre til stede. En online underskriftsindsamling for at stoppe henrettelsen indsamlede omkring 4.000 underskrifter. Uden for fængslet samledes demonstranter for at demonstrere mod dødsstraf.

article_content: In 2001, I arrived in Braddock, Pennsylvania, a town grappling with severe poverty in Western Pennsylvania. My purpose was to establish an employment and GED program to aid the area's marginalized young people. Their circumstances mirrored Braddock's decline, marked by disorder due to neglect. However, these difficult periods are not new; such challenges have persisted for decades. Once a vital hub for steel manufacturing worldwide, Braddock, or what remains of it, serves as a stark reminder of a particular economic principle: 'socialism for the rich, and capitalism for the poor.' Since the extensive banking bailout of 2008, I've often contemplated what Braddock might resemble today had the U.S. government invested similarly in the steel industry 35 years prior, preserving jobs and supporting families. Instead, areas such as Braddock were left to face decades of turmoil, poverty, and abandonment. Braddock's population dwindled from 20,000 to less than 3,000. The town appears as a desolate battleground; a large portion of its residents, buildings, businesses, and homes have vanished, leaving behind remnants of past struggles. In 2005, the same young individuals I had the opportunity to support played a crucial role in my election as mayor. Given the frequency of senseless homicides, I started to document the dates of these killings on my arm as a continuous memorial to our shared losses. Upon assuming office, we focused on revitalizing Braddock through strategies ranging from effective policing and artistic projects, to urban farming and youth employment programs. Currently, structures have been preserved and repurposed. We cultivate organic produce on land that was previously overgrown and can provide summer jobs for our youth. Notably, there have been no new additions to my forearm in over 20 months. Nevertheless, as I commence my second term as mayor, there is significant work ahead, and we will never fully recover what has been lost. As the saying indicates, we are not seeking a handout, but rather assistance and an opportunity to alleviate thirty years of socioeconomic decline. To that end, the stimulus, officially known as the American Recovery and Reinvestment Act of 2009, has provided genuine financial relief, especially since the community's hospital and major employer, the University of Pittsburgh Medical Center, declared it would be closing Braddock Hospital later this month, thereby cutting jobs and limiting health care access for our residents. Braddock was allocated $250,000 in stimulus funds to upgrade our sewer system for EPA compliance and $30,000, which enabled us to employ 30 additional young people during the past summer who would have otherwise been unemployed. Undeniably, these stimulus funds provided essential resources. However, I believe the most significant potential of the American Recovery and Reinvestment Act of 2009 is yet to be realized and now presents an unparalleled chance for advancement and revitalization. In Braddock and its neighboring regions, there are numerous high-quality, immediately actionable projects that vary in complexity and scale. These range from urban farming and the renovation of a vacant 300,000 square foot hospital, to a $300 million endeavor to transform a former steel mill site into a green enterprise zone for economic development. Investments such as these will not only contribute to reinventing communities like Braddock but will also drive job creation and promote long-term growth. These projects and similar ones nationwide represent a small portion of the funds used to rescue banks and Wall Street from their own greed. Perhaps more importantly, I believe this type of investment will help restore a sense of social justice, which is currently missing in public discourse. Consider the irony of bailed-out banking executives justifying multimillion-dollar bonuses while our community experiences over 30 percent unemployment, widespread abandonment, and pervasive poverty, compounded by the loss of our only hospital and restricted access to medical care. The explanation for this situation is simple: one received capitalism, and the other, socialism. Fundamental fairness dictates that one's occupation should not determine who receives a bailout and who is abandoned. For Americans residing in areas such as Braddock, I believe the American Recovery and Reinvestment Act is possibly the last chance to overcome the injustice and harm caused by decades of laissez-faire policies. The opinions expressed in this commentary are solely those of John Fetterman.

Mit formål var at etablere et beskæftigelses- og GED-program for at hjælpe områdets marginaliserede unge. Deres forhold afspejlede Braddocks nedgang, præget af uorden på grund af forsømmelse. Disse vanskelige perioder er dog ikke nye; sådanne udfordringer har varet ved i årtier. Engang et vigtigt centrum for stålproduktion på verdensplan, tjener Braddock, eller hvad der er tilbage af den, som en skarp påmindelse om et bestemt økonomisk princip: 'socialisme for de rige og kapitalisme for de fattige.' Siden den omfattende bankredningspakke i 2008 har jeg ofte tænkt over, hvordan Braddock kunne se ud i dag, hvis den amerikanske regering havde investeret tilsvarende i stålindustrien 35 år tidligere og bevaret job og støttet familier. I stedet blev områder som Braddock overladt til at stå over for årtier med uro, fattigdom og forladthed. Braddocks befolkning svandt ind fra 20.000 til mindre end 3.000. Byen fremstår som en øde slagmark; en stor del af dens beboere, bygninger, virksomheder og hjem er forsvundet og har efterladt rester af tidligere kampe. I 2005 spillede de samme unge mennesker, som jeg havde mulighed for at støtte, en afgørende rolle i min valg som borgmester. I betragtning af hyppigheden af ​​meningsløse drab begyndte jeg at dokumentere datoerne for disse drab på min arm som et kontinuerligt mindesmærke for vores fælles tab. Da jeg tiltrådte, fokuserede vi på at genoplive Braddock gennem strategier lige fra effektiv politiarbejde og kunstneriske projekter til bylandbrug og ungdomsbeskæftigelsesprogrammer. I øjeblikket er strukturer blevet bevaret og genanvendt. Vi dyrker økologiske produkter på jord, der tidligere var tilgroet, og kan tilbyde sommerjob til vores unge. Især er der ikke kommet nye tilføjelser til min underarm i over 20 måneder. Ikke desto mindre, når jeg påbegynder min anden periode som borgmester, er der et betydeligt arbejde foran os, og vi vil aldrig fuldt ud genvinde det, der er gået tabt. Som ordsproget siger, søger vi ikke en håndsrækning, men snarere hjælp og en mulighed for at afhjælpe tredive års socioøkonomisk tilbagegang. Med det formål har stimuleringen, officielt kendt som American Recovery and Reinvestment Act af 2009, ydet ægte økonomisk lindring, især da samfundets hospital og store arbejdsgiver, University of Pittsburgh Medical Center, erklærede, at det ville lukke Braddock Hospital senere på måneden og derved skære job og begrænse sundhedsplejeadgangen for vores beboere. Braddock blev tildelt $250.000 i stimulansmidler til at opgradere vores kloaksystem for EPA-overholdelse og $30.000, hvilket gjorde det muligt for os at ansætte 30 ekstra unge mennesker i løbet af den forgangne sommer, som ellers ville have været arbejdsløse. Det er ubestrideligt, at disse stimulansmidler tilførte væsentlige ressourcer. Jeg mener dog, at det mest betydningsfulde potentiale i American Recovery and Reinvestment Act af 2009 endnu ikke er realiseret og nu udgør en enestående chance for fremskridt og revitalisering. I Braddock og dets nabolande er der adskillige højkvalitets, umiddelbart gennemførlige projekter, der varierer i kompleksitet og omfang. Disse spænder fra bylandbrug og renovering af et ledigt hospital på 300.000 kvadratfod til en indsats på 300 millioner dollars for at omdanne en tidligere stålværksgrund til en grøn virksomhedszone for økonomisk udvikling. Investeringer som disse vil ikke kun bidrage til at genopfinde samfund som Braddock, men vil også drive jobskabelse og fremme langsigtet vækst. Disse projekter og lignende projekter over hele landet repræsenterer en lille del af de midler, der bruges til at redde banker og Wall Street fra deres egen grådighed. Måske endnu vigtigere tror jeg, at denne type investering vil hjælpe med at genoprette en følelse af social retfærdighed, som i øjeblikket mangler i den offentlige debat. Overvej ironien i, at redningsbankdirektører retfærdiggør bonusser på flere millioner dollars, mens vores samfund oplever over 30 procent arbejdsløshed, udbredt forladthed og gennemgribende fattigdom, forværret af tabet af vores eneste hospital og begrænset adgang til lægehjælp. Forklaringen på denne situation er enkel: den ene modtog kapitalisme, og den anden, socialisme. Grundlæggende retfærdighed tilsiger, at ens beskæftigelse ikke bør bestemme, hvem der modtager en redningspakke, og hvem der bliver forladt. For amerikanere, der bor i områder som Braddock, tror jeg, at American Recovery and Reinvestment Act muligvis er den sidste chance for at overvinde den uretfærdighed og skade, der er forårsaget af årtiers laissez-faire-politikker. De meninger, der udtrykkes i denne kommentar, er udelukkende John Fettermans.

article_content: Tehran, Iran (CNN) -- The release of American hiker Sarah Shourd has been 'canceled,' according to a prosecutor who spoke to the semiofficial Iranian Labour News Agency (ILNA) on Friday. Iranian officials had stated on Thursday that Shourd, one of three American hikers detained in Iran for over a year, would be released on Saturday. 'The news [of the impending release] is not approved by the judiciary, and naturally, any decision regarding the defendants is contingent upon the completion of the due process,' said Abas Jafari Dolatabadi, Tehran's public and revolutionary prosecutor, according to ILNA. The Islamic Republic News Agency (IRNA), an official agency of the Iranian government, cited the deputy director of the president's office of communications as saying that Shourd's release had only been 'postponed.' 'He said more details will be given later,' it added. Shourd, 32, along with Shane Bauer, 28, and Josh Fattal, 28, were detained on July 31, 2009, after they allegedly strayed across an unmarked border into Iran while hiking in the Kurdistan region of Iraq. Tehran has claimed the three hikers were spies, and Iran's intelligence minister has suggested the country might consider releasing them in exchange for Iranian prisoners, according to state news outlets. Masoud Shafii, the Iranian lawyer representing the hikers, said he submitted a formal request for the trio's release within the past two weeks. Shafii said he informed prosecutors that a year had passed since their arrests, the government had not presented any just cause for their imprisonment, and that Shourd has a medical condition requiring proper care. A spokeswoman for the families told CNN that Shourd informed her mother during their only visit, spanning two days in May, that she had discovered a lump in her breast. The hikers' families' website, freethehikers.org, stated that Shourd has been in solitary confinement and allowed only two 30-minute periods per day to meet with Bauer, her fiancé, and Fattal. The two men share a cell. The three Americans -- all graduates of the University of California, Berkeley -- have not been formally charged, according to the website. They are held in Evin Prison in Tehran, have been able to telephone their families only once on March 9, and have been denied access to their lawyer, the website adds. 'Shane, Sarah, and Josh care greatly about our world and have a documented record as advocates for social and environmental justice,' it says. 'They admire and respect different cultures and religions and share a love of travel that has taken them to many countries. That is why they went to Kurdistan, not because they wanted to enter Iran.' 'Their protracted detention without due process is illegal according to international and Iranian law and must end immediately. It is widely acknowledged that they are being held for political purposes that have nothing to do with the facts of their case. Their detention is arbitrary and inhumane, and we call on the Iranian authorities to release them without further delay.' CNN's Shirzad Bozorgmehr in Tehran and Mary Snow in New York contributed to this report.
translated_content: Teheran, Iran (CNN) -- Frigivelsen af den amerikanske vandrer Sarah Shourd er blevet 'aflyst', ifølge en anklager, der talte med det semiofficielle iranske Labour News Agency (ILNA) fredag. Iranske embedsmænd havde torsdag oplyst, at Shourd, en af tre amerikanske vandrere, der er tilbageholdt i Iran i over et år, ville blive frigivet lørdag. 'Nyheden [om den forestående frigivelse] er ikke godkendt af retsvæsenet, og naturligvis er enhver beslutning vedrørende de tiltalte betinget af, at retssagen er afsluttet,' sagde Abas Jafari Dolatabadi, Teherans offentlige anklager, ifølge ILNA. Det Islamiske Republiks Nyhedsbureau (IRNA), et officielt agentur for den iranske regering, citerede den assisterende direktør for præsidentens kommunikationskontor for at sige, at Shourds frigivelse kun var blevet 'udsatt'. 'Han sagde, at flere detaljer vil blive givet senere,' tilføjede han. Shourd, 32, sammen med Shane Bauer, 28, og Josh Fattal, 28, blev tilbageholdt den 31. juli 2009, efter at de angiveligt var kommet på afveje over en umarkeret grænse til Iran under en vandretur i Kurdistan-regionen i Irak. Teheran har hævdet, at de tre vandrere var spioner, og Irans efterretningsminister har antydet, at landet måske vil overveje at frigive dem i bytte for iranske fanger, ifølge statslige nyhedsmedier. Masoud Shafii, den iranske advokat, der repræsenterer vandrerne, sagde, at han havde indsendt en formel anmodning om trioens frigivelse inden for de seneste to uger. Shafii sagde, at han informerede anklagerne om, at der var gået et år siden deres anholdelser, at regeringen ikke havde fremlagt nogen rimelig grund til deres fængsling, og at Shourd har en medicinsk tilstand, der kræver ordentlig pleje. En talskvinde for familierne fortalte CNN, at Shourd informerede sin mor under deres eneste besøg, der strakte sig over to dage i maj, at hun havde opdaget en knude i sit bryst. Vandrernes familiers hjemmeside, freethehikers.org, oplyste, at Shourd har været i isolation og kun har fået lov til to perioder på 30 minutter om dagen til at mødes med Bauer, hendes forlovede, og Fattal. De to mænd deler en celle. De tre amerikanere - alle kandidater fra University of California, Berkeley - er ikke blevet formelt anklaget, ifølge hjemmesiden. De holdes i Evin-fængslet i Teheran, har kun kunnet tale i telefon med deres familier én gang den 9. marts og er blevet nægtet adgang til deres advokat, tilføjer hjemmesiden. 'Shane, Sarah og Josh holder meget af vores verden og har en dokumenteret baggrund som fortalere for social og miljømæssig retfærdighed,' står der. 'De beundrer og respekterer forskellige kulturer og religioner og deler en kærlighed til rejser, der har taget dem til mange lande. Det er derfor, de tog til Kurdistan, ikke fordi de ønskede at rejse ind i Iran.' 'Deres langvarige tilbageholdelse uden retssikkerhed er ulovlig i henhold til international og iransk lov og skal ophøre straks. Det er almindeligt anerkendt, at de holdes tilbage af politiske årsager, der ikke har noget at gøre med fakta i deres sag. Deres tilbageholdelse er vilkårlig og umenneskelig, og vi opfordrer de iranske myndigheder til at frigive dem uden yderligere forsinkelse.' CNN's Shirzad Bozorgmehr i Teheran og Mary Snow i New York bidrog til denne rapport.

article_content: David Hudson, a 43-year-old man, shed an impressive 17 stone after a wake-up call on an airplane. He had reached a point where he needed a seat belt typically used for pregnant women. Weighing 34 stone due to years of unhealthy eating habits like late-night fast food and excessive drinking, David had already been approved for gastric band surgery. However, the embarrassing incident during a 2010 flight to Turkey, coupled with meeting a friend who had successfully lost weight, pushed him to take matters into his own hands. Now at his goal weight of 17 stone, and standing tall at 6ft 8ins, David's doctor considers him healthy for his age. David, a CCTV engineer from Wallsend, North Tyneside, shared that seeing his friend's transformation motivated him: 'I thought if he can achieve it, then so can I.' His irregular work schedule, along with his wife Alison's late shifts managing a pub, led to the couple often eating very late. He admitted, 'I was consuming unhealthy junk, and gradually the weight accumulated. On that flight to Turkey, the flight attendant gave me a pregnant woman's seatbelt, and I was so squeezed into the seat that the person behind me had no legroom.' 'That was the absolute worst moment. You're conscious of people's glances, even when they try to be discreet, you can feel their eyes on you.' In his younger years, David was a passionate runner, but over time he gained weight. 'I used to be a runner and was nicknamed Rodney Trotter for being so thin, but by my late 20s, I started gaining weight.' By 2010, when he began his weight loss journey, he weighed 34 stone. After losing five stone independently over seven months, he felt progress had stalled.  Determined to continue, he joined a Slimming World class last year, consistently losing around half a stone each week. Over the course of eight months, he lost an additional 10 stone. David's success inspired his wife, Alison, to also join Slimming World. She has since lost two stone. He also learned to cook nutritious meals, received healthy recipes, and became a regular gym-goer, sometimes visiting up to 12 times a week. David recounted, 'The first time I spent three minutes on the treadmill, I felt like I would pass out. But I returned the next day and did 10 minutes, and now I can complete an hour-long cardio session.' Over 36 weeks, he lost more than 10 stone and currently weighs 17st 10lb. His Slimming World consultant has said that it is the most significant weight loss she has ever witnessed. David emphasized, 'The Slimming World sessions gave me the focus I needed each week to ensure the numbers on the scale kept decreasing.'

article_content: Roy Hodgson refused to fully endorse Ross Barkley despite the young Everton midfielder's impressive performance in Miami. Speaking to reporters after the 2-2 draw with Ecuador, Hodgson also stated he would not address the 'obsession' surrounding starting the 20-year-old against Italy in Manaus. Hodgson commented: 'I thought Wayne Rooney played very well, and Ross Barkley had some good moments. He needs to learn when to turn with the ball and when to retain possession. Barkley's performance was impressive in the 2-2 draw against Ecuador, but Hodgson believes there's room for improvement. Hodgson declined to be drawn on the question of Barkley's potential involvement in Manaus. 'But that's normal for a player of his age. He should be pleased to have played for so long on his first start.' When asked if Barkley would be among the starters against Italy, Hodgson responded: 'There always seems to be an enormous obsession with one player. I am prepared to start any of the players in any game, but I'm not prepared to discuss your obsession with Ross Barkley. If he's going to be the player we want him to be, he has to make better decisions about when to turn with the ball. Barkley, 20, displayed control and composure in his first England start. Lambert scored a powerful goal following a driving run by Barkley. That's not a criticism, but other players also performed well today. Oxlade-Chamberlain and Phil Jones were outstanding, as was Jack Wilshere in midfield, while Rickie Lambert scored a magnificent goal.' In an engaging game, England initially trailed, then took the lead before Ecuador equalized with a powerful strike from Michael Arroyo. Raheem Sterling and Antonio Valencia were both dismissed after Valencia reacted strongly to a challenge from Sterling - Sterling won the ball but will now be suspended for the final World Cup warm-up against Honduras on Saturday. Sterling will be absent from the friendly against Honduras following his sending off. Alex Oxlade-Chamberlain was forced off early due to a knee injury. 'I thought it was a very good game,' Hodgson added. I was disappointed with the sendings off and the potential injury to Alex Oxlade-Chamberlain (who sustained possible ligament damage) - but as a friendly, a warm-up match for our players, it was beneficial. They tested us, but we coped well for extended periods and created numerous problems for their defence. We could have had several goals before they scored. If the players perform as well as they did on Saturday, we'll go to Brazil and Manaus with great confidence.'
translated_content: Roy Hodgson nægtede at give Ross Barkley fuld opbakning, på trods af den unge Everton-midtbane spillers imponerende præstation i Miami. Efter 2-2 kampen mod Ecuador udtalte Hodgson desuden til journalister, at han ikke ville kommentere på 'besættelsen' omkring at starte den 20-årige mod Italien i Manaus. Hodgson bemærkede: 'Jeg syntes, Wayne Rooney spillede rigtig godt, og Ross Barkley havde nogle gode øjeblikke. Han skal lære, hvornår han kan vende rundt med bolden, og hvornår han skal holde fast i den. Barkleys præstation var imponerende i 2-2 kampen mod Ecuador, men Hodgson mener, at der er rum til forbedring. Hodgson ønskede ikke at kommentere spørgsmålet om Barkleys mulige deltagelse i Manaus. 'Men det er normalt for en spiller på hans alder. Han bør være tilfreds med at have spillet så længe i sin første kamp fra start.' På spørgsmålet om, hvorvidt Barkley ville være blandt de startende mod Italien, svarede Hodgson: 'Der lader altid til at være en enorm besættelse af én bestemt spiller. Jeg er villig til at lade enhver af spillerne starte i en hvilken som helst kamp, men jeg er ikke villig til at diskutere jeres besættelse af Ross Barkley. Hvis han skal blive den spiller, vi ønsker, at han skal være, skal han træffe bedre beslutninger om, hvornår han skal vende rundt med bolden. Barkley, 20, udviste kontrol og ro i sin første kamp for England fra start. Lambert scorede et kraftfuldt mål efter et fremragende løb af Barkley. Det er ikke ment som kritik, men andre spillere præsterede også godt i dag. Oxlade-Chamberlain og Phil Jones var fremragende, ligesom Jack Wilshere på midtbanen, mens Rickie Lambert scorede et pragtfuldt mål!' article_content: In a New Hampshire courtroom, the parents of murdered teenager Elizabeth Marriott confronted her killer, holding up a photograph as Seth Mazzaglia received his life sentence. Mazzaglia, 31, received the maximum sentence for the murder of 19-year-old Marriott, from Westborough, Massachusetts. He showed no emotion as Marriott's family addressed the court. Mazzaglia attempted to avoid the hearing, saying he didn't want to hear the family's complaints. In June, Mazzaglia was convicted of first-degree murder. Key witness Kathryn McDonough testified she lured Marriott to the apartment as a 'sexual offering'. Melissa Marriott, Lizzi's mother, confronted Mazzaglia, stating, 'I want you to know that I unequivocally hate you...You murdered Lizzi, raped her lifeless body'. Mazzaglia denied killing Marriott but apologized for the family's loss, stating he helped cover up the death and showed investigators where he left her body. Before sentencing, Mazzaglia's mother, Heather Mazzaglia, apologized to the Marriotts and gave Bob Marriott a note expressing her sorrow. McDonough testified she lured Marriott to the apartment as an offering. When Marriott refused Mazzaglia's advances, he strangled and raped her. They disposed of her body in a river; it has never been found. McDonough is serving 1 1/2 to 3 years for hindering prosecution. Relatives, friends, and jurors attended the sentencing. A portrait of Elizabeth Marriott holding a frog was displayed, facing Mazzaglia. His parents were separated from Marriott's family. McDonough initially said Marriott died during consensual rough sex, later testifying that Mazzaglia strangled Marriott after she refused him.

Mazzaglia nægtede at have dræbt Marriott, men undskyldte for familiens tab og sagde, at han havde hjulpet med at dække over hendes død, og viste efterforskere, hvor han havde efterladt hendes lig. Før domsafsigelsen undskyldte Mazzaglias mor, Heather Mazzaglia, over for familien Marriott og gav Bob Marriott en seddel, hvor hun udtrykte sin sorg. article_content: Elizabeth Romanaux, 55, embodies the millions of unemployed Americans striving to re-enter the job market. Earlier this year, she worked as an unpaid intern for a public relations firm in New Jersey, maintaining a positive attitude despite the circumstances. As a former media relations manager, her tasks included building contact lists and fetching lunches, all in an effort to enhance her chances of securing full-time employment. Ms. Romanaux is among the many older Americans facing challenges in finding jobs and keeping their skills current in what is considered one of the toughest labor markets in recent decades. While internships were traditionally for high school and college students, older workers are now using them to strengthen their resumes between jobs. 'You sometimes have to accept the situation and do what a 17-year-old would gladly do,' Ms. Romanaux stated. Margo Rose, the founder of HireFriday, an online job search advice website, noted that many laid-off adults are exploring new avenues to improve their CVs. She emphasized the importance of having a ready answer when interviewers ask about recent activities. Careers advisor Liz Ryan mentioned that requests from mid-career clients seeking internship assistance have significantly increased since 2008. 'There has definitely been almost an explosion of this kind of thing,' she explained, noting an increase from approximately 20 such clients in 2008 to 36 annually in 2009 and 2010. Ms. Ryan suggests that Will Smith's 2006 film, ‘The Pursuit of Happyness,’ may have contributed to the rise in post-college-age internships. The film depicts Mr. Smith's character losing everything in a failed business venture before securing a stock brokerage internship that eventually leads to a job. Phil Gardner, who analyzes initial employment at Michigan State University, observed a significant increase in graduates undertaking internships, although this trend has eased with improvements in the labor market earlier in the year. College internships gained popularity in the 1970s, coinciding with the baby boomer generation entering universities. Between 1970 and 1983, the number of colleges and universities offering internship programs rose from 200 to 1,000. 'If I could get someone like me for free, I would be apologetic about it, but I would do it,' said Elizabeth Romanaux. The growing number of older interns highlights a broader issue in the labor market, where job seekers struggle to find suitable employment. In May, while the unemployment rate was at 9.1 per cent, nearly 16 per cent of Americans were ‘underemployed,’ meaning they were either unemployed and searching, working part-time involuntarily, or discouraged from seeking work. Recent Labour Department data indicated a slight decrease of 1,000 in initial claims for unemployment benefits, bringing the seasonally adjusted total to 428,000. This figure remains above the 400,000 mark that would signal a positive shift in the labor market. Margo Rose of HireFriday emphasized the importance of being prepared to answer questions about recent activities during job interviews. Ms. Romanaux, now working as a freelance consultant for the same museum that previously laid her off, expressed gratitude for her internship, which concluded in May. She recognizes the economic rationale behind employing older workers as interns and valued the opportunity to learn about social media without incurring educational costs. However, she acknowledged the challenges of starting over at 55 and the difficulties she faced in the early stages of her internship. 'It was very stressful,' she admitted. 'Even though they weren't paying me, I felt badly I couldn't do it well.'
translated_content: Elizabeth Romanaux, 55, er indbegrebet af de millioner af arbejdsløse amerikanere, der stræber efter at komme tilbage på arbejdsmarkedet. Tidligere i år arbejdede hun som ulønnet praktikant for et PR-firma i New Jersey og bevarede en positiv indstilling trods omstændighederne. Som tidligere medierelationschef inkluderede hendes opgaver at opbygge kontaktlister og hente frokoster, alt sammen i et forsøg på at forbedre hendes chancer for at sikre sig en fuldtidsansættelse. Ms. Romanaux er blandt de mange ældre amerikanere, der står over for udfordringer med at finde job og holde deres færdigheder opdaterede i, hvad der betragtes som et af de sværeste arbejdsmarkeder i de seneste årtier. Mens praktikophold traditionelt var forbeholdt gymnasie- og universitetsstuderende, bruger ældre arbejdstagere dem nu til at styrke deres CV'er mellem jobs. 'Man er nogle gange nødt til at bide i det sure æble og gøre, hvad en 17-årig med glæde ville gøre,' udtalte Ms. Romanaux. Margo Rose, grundlæggeren af HireFriday, en online jobrådgivningshjemmeside, bemærkede, at mange afskedigede voksne undersøger nye veje til at forbedre deres CV'er. Hun understregede vigtigheden af at have et godt svar parat, når interviewere spørger om nylige aktiviteter. Karrierevejleder Liz Ryan nævnte, at anmodninger fra midtkarriereklienter, der søger hjælp til praktikophold, er steget markant siden 2008. 'Der har helt sikkert været næsten en eksplosion i denne type henvendelser,' forklarede hun og bemærkede en stigning fra cirka 20 sådanne klienter i 2008 til 36 årligt i 2009 og 2010. Ms. Ryan antyder, at Will Smiths film fra 2006, 'The Pursuit of Happyness', kan have bidraget til stigningen i antallet af praktikophold for folk i en sen alder. Filmen skildrer, hvordan Mr. Smiths karakter mister alt i et mislykket forretningsforetagende, før han sikrer sig et praktikophold som aktiemægler, der til sidst fører til et job. Phil Gardner, der analyserer førstegangsbeskæftigelse ved Michigan State University, observerede en betydelig stigning i antallet af kandidater, der tager praktikophold, selvom denne tendens er aftaget med forbedringer i arbejdsmarkedet tidligere på året. Praktikophold på college blev populære i 1970'erne, hvilket faldt sammen med, at babyboomergenerationen strømmede til universiteterne. Mellem 1970 og 1983 steg antallet af colleges og universiteter, der tilbyder praktikprogrammer, fra 200 til 1.000. 'Hvis jeg kunne få en som mig gratis, ville jeg være undskyldende, men jeg ville gøre det,' sagde Elizabeth Romanaux. Det voksende antal ældre praktikanter fremhæver et bredere problem på arbejdsmarkedet, hvor jobsøgende kæmper for at finde passende beskæftigelse. I maj, mens ledigheden var på 9,1 procent, var næsten 16 procent af amerikanerne 'underbeskæftigede', hvilket betyder, at de enten var arbejdsløse og søgte job, arbejdede ufrivilligt på deltid eller var blevet afskrækket fra at søge job. Nylige data fra arbejdsministeriet viste et lille fald på 1.000 i de første ansøgninger om arbejdsløshedsunderstøttelse, hvilket bringer det sæsonkorrigerede samlede tal ned på 428.000. Dette tal ligger stadig over de 400.000, der ville signalere en positiv udvikling på arbejdsmarkedet. Margo Rose fra HireFriday understregede vigtigheden af at være forberedt på at besvare spørgsmål om nylige aktiviteter under jobsamtaler. Ms. Romanaux, der nu arbejder som freelancekonsulent for det samme museum, der tidligere afskedigede hende, udtrykte taknemmelighed for sit praktikophold, som sluttede i maj. Hun erkender den økonomiske logik i at ansætte ældre arbejdstagere som praktikanter og værdsatte muligheden for at lære om sociale medier uden at skulle betale for det. Hun anerkendte dog de udfordringer, der er forbundet med at starte forfra som 55-årig, og de vanskeligheder, hun oplevede i de tidlige stadier af sit praktikophold. 'Det var meget stressende,' indrømmede hun. 'Selvom de ikke betalte mig, havde jeg det dårligt med, at jeg ikke kunne gøre det ordentligt.'

article_content: Tiffany Porter stated she was inspired by the 'Mo and Jo effect' to win gold in the 100m hurdles, praising the positive atmosphere in the Great Britain camp. 'Hopefully, this will kick-start a further gold rush,' she said after securing Britain’s seventh gold at the European Championships in Zurich. 'What we’ve achieved so far is really special. A key factor was the speech that our captain, Goldie Sayers, gave on Monday night. She encouraged us to compete as if it were our last championships, which really resonated with me.' Porter became the first British woman to win European gold in the sprint hurdles. The 26-year-old, originally from Michigan, was the fastest qualifier in the heats and semi-final. She maintained her dominance, winning gold in 12.76 seconds. Porter had a powerful start and held her lead over France’s Cindy Billaud, who finished strongly to take silver. The 26-year-old, who won World Championship bronze in Moscow last year and silver at the Commonwealth Games in Glasgow, said: 'This is my first gold medal for Britain, and I couldn’t be happier. I just focused on myself.' 'We all train for gold – I focused on my lane and performed well when it mattered most.' Germany’s Cindy Roleder took bronze in 12.82 seconds. Ashleigh Nelson, 23, was emotional after becoming Britain’s first female sprinting medalist at the European Championships in 40 years, following Andrea Lynch’s 100m bronze in 1974. Nelson clocked 11.22 seconds to clinch her first medal at a major championship. 'I feel amazing, as you can tell from the tears,' she said. 'I’m just so happy. My coach knew what I was capable of and told me to give it everything in the final, and look what’s happened.' All four GB one-lap specialists advanced to the final. The men — Martyn Rooney, Conrad Williams, and Matt Hudson-Smith — all won their semi-finals. Hudson-Smith, the youngest of the trio at 19, received advice from veteran Rooney. 'Martyn advised me to be comfortable, and my coach said to just get to the final. I’m surrounded by good people.' Christine Ohuruogu won her 400m semi-final but appeared strained. 'I didn’t feel fresh,' she said, 'But this is my first European Championships, so I want to win a medal.'

Hun opfordrede os til at konkurrere, som om det var vores sidste mesterskab, og det gav virkelig genklang hos mig.' Porter blev den første britiske kvinde til at vinde EM-guld i sprint hæk. article_content: TV presenter Dan Snow has lost a planning dispute to demolish an orangery on the grounds of his £7 million country mansion and construct an office in its place. As an award-winning TV historian, Dan Snow has often celebrated Britain’s architectural heritage. However, his own building project was deemed unsuitable by local officials. The Battlefield Britain presenter and his wife, Lady Edwina Grosvenor, submitted plans to facilitate working from their 18th-century home in the New Forest. Snow, 36, and Lady Edwina, 33 – daughter of the Duke of Westminster, one of Britain’s richest landowners, and potential inheritor of a portion of his £8.5 billion fortune – desired a detached office to separate work from family life with their two young children. The New Forest National Park Authority rejected the application, citing concerns about the size and the building's resemblance to 'something you would find on an industrial estate'. The couple acquired the four-bedroom house in Exbury, Hampshire, from Simon Mann, a convicted mercenary, for a reported £10 million in 2009. Snow sought to replace a 1970s neoclassical-style orangery with a modern, eco-friendly building. The proposed 3,000 sq ft structure, clad in timber and corrugated metal to achieve an ‘agricultural feel’, would provide boat storage and meeting space for the charities they support. The TV presenter also intended to host university student tutorials and allow occasional community use. He told the NPA's planning and development control committee it would replace an 'appalling building that is effectively derelict'. 'It would not be visible from the road and would only be partially visible from the river,' he stated. A report included in the couple's planning application noted: 'Both have high-profile jobs and are in public and media demand. This necessitates considerable travel, and with two very young children, they wish to work from home as much as possible while maintaining a degree of separation from the main house for a better work-life balance. Dan also works with university students and would like to use the facility for tutorials and training. Both Dan and Edwina are patrons of numerous charities and desire to hold periodic meetings at their home rather than traveling to London.' However, NPA members criticized the project's scale and design. Cllr David Harrison commented: 'I understand the applicants' proposal, but it resembles something you would find on an industrial estate. We have a duty to approve schemes that enhance, not detract - and I believe this detracts.' The committee's reasons for refusal included: 'The proposed home office/studio, due to its scale, size, form, appearance, and intended use, is not considered incidental or appropriate to the main and secondary dwellings at the site or the curtilage. It would also facilitate the creation of a separate dwelling with only minimal internal alteration required. As such, it contravenes the New Forest National Park Core Strategy and Development requirements.' The couple retains the option to appeal the decision. The application received support from the chairman of Exbury and Lepe Parish Council, Peter Hayward-Broomfield. He stated: 'The applicants are busy people with diverse careers. They require a suitable working environment separate from home and domestic distractions. It will have minimal visual or other impact on the local community.' Wendy Perring, from design firm Pad Studio, indicated that the New Forest National Park Authority was primarily concerned about potential residential use of the office. Mr. Snow, whose father's cousin is Channel 4 News presenter Jon Snow, 67, graduated with first-class honors in Modern History from the University of Oxford before starting his presenting career. He has presented numerous history programs for the BBC and other broadcasters and has a regular history segment on The One Show. Battlefield Britain, which aired in 2004, received a BAFTA Craft Award for special effects. In the same year, Snow received a Sony award as one of the presenters on the LBC Boat Race. Lady Edwina's father, Gerald Grosvenor, 63, is Britain's richest landowner, and she is poised to inherit a portion of his £8.5 billion fortune. The property was previously owned by Simon Mann, 62, a mercenary and former British Army officer. Mann was sentenced to 34 years in prison in Equatorial Guinea for his involvement in a failed Government coup in 2004 but received a presidential pardon on humanitarian grounds on 2 November 2009. Mr. Snow was unavailable for comment when contacted.
translated_content: Tv-vært Dan Snow har tabt en planlægningssag om at rive et orangeri ned på grunden af sit landsted til 7 millioner pund og opføre et kontor i stedet. Som en prisvindende tv-historiker har Dan Snow ofte hyldet Storbritanniens arkitektoniske arv. Dog blev hans eget byggeprojekt anset for uegnet af lokale embedsmænd. Værten for 'Battlefield Britain' og hans kone, Lady Edwina Grosvenor, indsendte planer for at kunne arbejde fra deres hjem fra det 18. århundrede i New Forest. Snow, 36, og Lady Edwina, 33 – datter af hertugen af Westminster, en af Storbritanniens rigeste godsejere, og potentiel arving til en del af hans formue på 8,5 milliarder pund – ønskede et separat kontor for at adskille arbejde fra familieliv med deres to små børn. New Forest National Park Authority afviste ansøgningen med henvisning til bekymringer om størrelsen og bygningens lighed med 'noget, man ville finde på et industriområde'. Parret erhvervede huset med fire soveværelser i Exbury, Hampshire, fra Simon Mann, en dømt lejesoldat, for angiveligt 10 millioner pund i 2009. Snow ønskede at erstatte et orangeri i neoklassisk stil fra 1970'erne med en moderne, miljøvenlig bygning. Den foreslåede bygning på 279 kvadratmeter, beklædt med træ og bølgeblik for at give den et 'landligt udseende', ville give plads til opbevaring af både samt mødelokaler til de velgørende organisationer, de støtter. Tv-værten havde også til hensigt at afholde undervisning for universitetsstuderende og lejlighedsvis lade lokalsamfundet bruge det. Han fortalte NPA's planlægnings- og udviklingsudvalg, at det ville erstatte en 'forfærdelig bygning, der reelt er faldefærdig'. 'Det ville ikke være synligt fra vejen og kun delvist fra floden,' sagde han. En rapport, der var inkluderet i parrets byggeansøgning, bemærkede: 'Begge har profileret job og er efterspurgte i offentligheden og medierne. Dette nødvendiggør en del rejser, og med to meget små børn ønsker de at arbejde hjemmefra så meget som muligt, samtidig med at de har en vis adskillelse fra hovedhuset for at opnå en bedre balance mellem arbejde og privatliv. Dan arbejder også med universitetsstuderende og vil gerne kunne bruge faciliteterne til undervisning og træning. Både Dan og Edwina er protektorer for adskillige velgørende organisationer og ønsker at kunne afholde periodiske møder i deres hjem i stedet for at skulle rejse til London.' NPA-medlemmer kritiserede dog projektets omfang og design. Byrådsmedlem David Harrison kommenterede: 'Jeg forstår ansøgernes forslag, men det ligner noget, man ville finde på et industriområde. Vi har pligt til at godkende projekter, der forbedrer frem for at forringe - og jeg mener, at dette projekt er en forringelse.' Udvalgets begrundelser for afslag omfattede: 'Det foreslåede hjemmekontor/studie anses på grund af dets omfang, størrelse, form, udseende og tilsigtede anvendelse ikke for at være passende i forhold til de primære og sekundære boliger på stedet eller grundarealet. Det ville også gøre det lettere at skabe en separat bolig med kun minimale interne ændringer. Som sådan er det i strid med New Forest National Parks overordnede strategi og udviklingskrav.' Parret har stadig mulighed for at anke afgørelsen. Ansøgningen blev støttet af formanden for Exbury og Lepe Parish Council, Peter Hayward-Broomfield. Han sagde: 'Ansøgerne er travle mennesker med alsidige karrierer. De har brug for et passende arbejdsmiljø adskilt fra hjemmet og distraktioner derfra. Det vil have minimal visuel eller anden indvirkning på lokalsamfundet.' Wendy Perring fra designfirmaet Pad Studio indikerede, at New Forest National Park Authority primært var bekymret for, at kontoret potentielt ville blive brugt som bolig. Hr. Snow, hvis fars fætter er Channel 4 News-vært Jon Snow, 67, dimitterede med udmærkelse i moderne historie fra University of Oxford, før han startede sin karriere som tv-vært. Han har præsenteret adskillige historiske programmer for BBC og andre tv-stationer og har et fast historisk indslag i The One Show. 'Battlefield Britain', der blev sendt i 2004, modtog en BAFTA Craft Award for special effects. Samme år modtog Snow en Sony Award som en af værterne på LBC Boat Race. Lady Edwinas far, Gerald Grosvenor, 63, er Storbritanniens rigeste godsejer, og hun står til at arve en del af hans formue på 8,5 milliarder pund. Ejendommen var tidligere ejet af Simon Mann, 62, en lejesoldat og tidligere britisk officer. Mann blev idømt 34 års fængsel i Ækvatorialguinea for sin involvering i et mislykket regeringskup i 2004, men blev benådet af præsidenten af humanitære årsager den 2. november 2009. Hr. Snow var ikke tilgængelig for kommentar, da han blev kontaktet.
